resources.string: Hold e-ink display to phone to update
Hold your e-ink display against the back of your phone to update

PaperTap writes QR codes to NFC e-paper displays.

To get started:
• Share a PDF or image with PaperTap
• Or tap "Extract QR Code" to select from your gallery or camera

Once extracted, hold your e-paper display to the back of your phone to flash the QR code.
